data.name: Saravanakumar
data.long_meaning: The name Saravanakumar is a combination of two words: Saravan and Kumar. Saravan means 'God of War' in Tamil. Kumar is a common title for young boys in Hindu culture, which means 'younger brother of God'. Together, Saravanakumar means 'Auspicious One, God of War'.
